[SWS_DM_00100] Supported Service subfunction level checks
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance shall check, whether there is a configured inter-
nal or external service processor for the incoming diagnostic request. If there exists
a service processor on SID level, but not for the subfunction of the request, the Ver-
ification shall be considered as failed and the negative response code shall be 0x12
(subFunctionNotSupported)
⌋
